rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for things someone owns, especially assets or belongings treated as property.

example.english: These assets are property my father left me.
example.traditional: 呢啲財產係我阿爸留畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 coi4 caan2 hai6 ngo5 aa3 baa4 lau4 bei2 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for real estate or a property consisting of land and buildings.

example.english: They bought a property in Sai Kung.
example.traditional: 佢喺西貢買咗一層物業。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 sai1 gung3 maai5 zo2 jat1 cang4 mat6 jip6

rows.note: Use this for an inherent or measurable property of a material, substance, or class of objects.

example.english: The property of this material is very stable.
example.traditional: 呢種物料嘅性質好穩定。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 mat6 liu6 ge3 sing3 zat1 hou2 wan2 ding6

rows.note: Use this for a distinctive quality or attribute of a person, object, or concept.

example.jyutping: sai3 sam1 hai6 keoi5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 dak6 zat1
